creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since 2026-10-05 a muster msg verb starts this install's daemon when none runs. On the Mac a bundle's daemon goes through Launch Services, outside the caller's sandbox; on a devenv it is spawned, so a daemon started from Codex's Linux sandbox (landlock + seccomp) might inherit it, and every pane it starts with it. macOS's deny-network profile fails cleanly (the daemon cannot listen, exit 3). Check with ./dev --codex or --ssh: muster msg who with no daemon, inside Codex's Linux sandbox.
title: Check whether a sandboxed agent on a devenv can start a daemon that carries its sandbox
